instruction: Look at the target or mark.

warning: Do not look at the ground.
Do not look at your feet.
Do not look at the ground.
In a gainer, think 'look at the wall in front of you' so fear does not make you look at the floor when you land.

instruction: Do not look at your feet or the ground.
Look at the horizon, as if you were looking at something far away; the head turns with the body.
warning: Your eyes do not go down.
In a TD raiz with a hand, glance at where you place it and quickly return to the front.

instruction: Look where you are going to come out.
The head turns with the body; find a point over your shoulder (b-twist, aerial).
warning: Do not look at the ground.

label: Cartwheel and Round Off
instruction: Look at the ground when you are about to place your hands.
warning: The moment your feet touch the floor, lift your gaze forward so you stand up well.

label: Scoot
instruction: Quickly look at the ground to place your hand.
warning: During the slide and when you stand up, look forward.

label: Flic Flac
instruction: As you jump, look backward (as if at the ceiling or the wall behind you).
warning: Do not look at your hands when they touch the floor.

label: Flic Flac
instruction: When you land on your feet, look forward.

label: Coindrop
instruction: Look at the ground to calculate the fall.
warning: Just before impact, turn your face to the side so you do not break your nose.
